Requires genuine understanding of the coupling, instability detection, and numerical implementation. Not a standard library call.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two sequential steps: compute HF stress profile then iteratively solve slip and detect instability. Uses standard Python stack (numpy/scipy), no complex tooling or data fetching. Straightforward I/O.
